messages.subject: Creating a provisional diagram
parts:
Good morning,

I am looking to create a provisional diagram for my thesis which I'm currently writing. I have managed to create a diagram, though the formatting of it is unusable, so I am looking to find suitable code to create a more user friendly diagram.

I have found a method on https://statistics.ohlsen-web.de/sem-path-diagram/ and attempted to replicate the code from that for my diagram, but am plagued with errors. Could anyone please advise on how I could get this code to work? I have attached a series of screenshots.

Kind regards,

Dave

messages.author: 189d19347ab44a74
messages.subject: Re: Creating a provisional diagram
parts:
For the grViz code, you start off with a > after the command prompt >. 

If you rerun that code without the > it should advance past your first error and maybe all of them. 

It might be a good idea to review basic R stuff in general if you haven’t.
